violated_contract: Sensitive derived voice evidence must retain owner encryption, bounded retention and the deletion lifecycle of its source; a hashed key and TTL do not authorize plaintext biometric payloads in a generic cache.
canonical_prevention: Store derived evidence behind the private owner-encrypted storage authority, within the conversation audio prefix and owner write fence. Bound its entry count, dimensions and usable lifetime. Exercise actual serialization, encryption/decryption, owner-key isolation, write rejection and conversation/account purge through the production cache APIs; mocking the cache writer cannot establish this contract.
